program.name: Senior Real Estate Planning
program.tagline: The Smart Way to Real Estate
program.summary: Consultative planning for senior homeowners and families navigating Prop 13, legacy homes, trusts, timing, and transition options in Lamorinda.
program.audience: Senior homeowners planning their next chapter and adult children who need a structured way to start the conversation before a crisis.
topics: Prop 13 tax basis and capital gains questions to raise with your CPA
Legacy home decisions: stay, downsize, rent, or sell on your timeline
Trust and titling coordination with your estate attorney
Options many families do not know they have, including 1031 exchanges, DSTs, and step-up in basis concepts to discuss with advisors
whatBenDoes: Helps families plan transitions on their own terms
Coordinates real estate strategy with questions for CPA and estate attorney
May recommend keeping a home as a rental when that fits the family, even when it means no listing commission
program.compliance: Ben Olsen is a licensed REALTOR, not an attorney, financial advisor, or CPA. Tax and estate topics are questions to raise with qualified professionals.

faq.question: When should a senior homeowner start thinking about a real estate transition?
faq.answer: Before a health event forces urgent decisions. Planning ahead preserves more options and autonomy.

faq.question: What is Prop 13 and why does it matter if I am thinking about selling?
faq.answer: Long-held California homes often have low assessed values. Selling can trigger capital gains your CPA should model with you first.

faq.question: Should I sell my Lamorinda home or keep it as a rental?
faq.answer: Depends on Prop 13 basis, equity, family housing needs, and rental demand. Ben helps evaluate the tradeoffs without giving tax advice.

faq.question: Does Ben charge for a senior real estate planning consultation?
faq.answer: Contact the office to discuss consultation format. This page does not publish fee schedules.
